verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say it integrates with your cloud stack and continuously monitors systems, with automated evidence collection and integration-driven checks (e.g., FreeAgent offboarding and role checks, access-check monitoring, integration monitoring). These claims are high-level marketing statements, and the AI gap-analysis feature validating *uploaded* screenshots shows manual evidence uploads remain part of the workflow. Missing for 10: documented collection schedules/frequency, description of timestamped machine-gathered artifacts replacing screenshots/CSVs, per-integration detail on what evidence is pulled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
